raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Support hybrid and external data parallel load balancing in standalone `vllm-rs serve`, with the same flags as `vllm serve`: one Rust frontend per node or per DP rank, each serving only its own ranks.

Top of a stack: vllm-project/vllm#64449 → vllm-project/vllm#64450 → this PR.

## Claims

- `vllm-rs serve` accepts `--data-parallel-hybrid-lb`, `--data-parallel-external-lb`, `--data-parallel-rank` (or `VLLM_DP_RANK`), and `--data-parallel-start-rank` outside `--headless`. Until now the first three were rejected as unsupported.
- A hybrid-LB frontend serves its node's ranks, and an external-LB frontend serves its single rank. `X-data-parallel-rank` takes the global rank.
- For MoE models, the rank-0 frontend runs the DP coordinator and the other frontends follow its waves.

## Validation

GB200 node, DP 4 with one GPU per rank, `--enforce-eager`, `--max-model-len 2048`, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.3`:

| Scenario | Result |
| --- | --- |
| MoE (`TitanML/tiny-mixtral`), internal LB, two launchers: rank 0 plus `--headless --data-parallel-start-rank 2` | Requests pinned to ranks 0–3 and an unpinned request return 200; 32/32 concurrent requests succeed |
| MoE, hybrid LB: frontend 8100 with ranks 0–1 (`--data-parallel-hybrid-lb`), frontend 8101 with ranks 2–3 (`--data-parallel-start-rank 2`) | Own ranks and unpinned requests return 200 on both; rank 0 pinned on 8101 returns 400; bursts of 32 sent to 8101 only, then 8100 only, then 8101 again all return 200 |
| MoE, external LB: four frontends with `--data-parallel-rank 0..3` | Each returns 200; 32 concurrent requests to rank 3's frontend only all return 200, which needs the other ranks' engines to follow its waves |
| Dense (`Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B`), hybrid LB: same layout as the MoE hybrid run | Own ranks and unpinned requests return 200 on both frontends, with the same greedy output on every rank; bursts of 32 sent to 8100 only and to 8101 only all return 200 |

All rows are from the current heads of this stack.

<details>
<summary>Hybrid LB commands</summary>

```bash
COMMON="--data-parallel-size 4 --data-parallel-size-local 2 --data-parallel-address 127.0.0.1 \
  --data-parallel-rpc-port 29652 --max-model-len 2048 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.3 --enforce-eager"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 vllm-rs serve TitanML/tiny-mixtral $COMMON --data-parallel-hybrid-lb --port 8100
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2,3 vllm-rs serve TitanML/tiny-mixtral $COMMON --data-parallel-start-rank 2 --port 8101
```

External LB: one process per rank `r` with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$r vllm-rs serve TitanML/tiny-mixtral --data-parallel-size 4 --data-parallel-rank $r --data-parallel-address 127.0.0.1 --data-parallel-rpc-port 29653 --port $((8100 + r)) ...`.

</details>

Tests (these use inline `expect-test` snapshots):

- `resolve_follows_vllm_serve_dp_lb_modes` (in `vllm-managed-engine`, next to the resolution rules in the new `data_parallel` module): a table of flag combinations and the resulting ranks or error.
- `serve_rank_zero_frontend_hosts_the_coordinator_for_its_single_rank`: an external-LB rank-0 frontend with one local rank still runs the coordinator.
- `serve_hybrid_lb_frontend_connects_only_its_ranks`: a rank-2 frontend's client config and the Python engine command it launches.
- `cargo nextest run --workspace` in `rust/`: 2385 passed; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

The Python change (a hidden `vllm serve` flag) is not covered by Python CI; the GPU runs above exercise it.

## Details

Flag resolution follows `vllm serve`'s `EngineArgs.create_engine_config`:

- A start rank outside `--headless` implies hybrid LB, and hybrid LB with every rank on the node is internal LB.
- `--data-parallel-rank` selects external LB with one local rank.
- Without `--data-parallel-size-local`, the start rank is ignored.
- Rejected: hybrid together with external LB, hybrid LB with `--headless`, a rank together with a start rank, external LB without a rank or with a local size other than 1, hybrid LB without a local size, and a rank range beyond the DP size.

Launch: the rank-0 frontend binds the shared handshake on `--data-parallel-address:--data-parallel-rpc-port`, as before. Any other frontend binds a local IPC handshake and starts its managed Python engines as a headless node with its start rank and local size, passing that endpoint as the new hidden `--headless-client-handshake-address`. `run_headless` hands it to `CoreEngineProcManager` as `client_handshake_address` with `local_client=True`, so the engines handshake with rank 0 for the coordinator and rendezvous and with their own frontend for input/output. The README gains a section on these modes.

Differences from `vllm serve`:

- `--data-parallel-rpc-port` has no default in hybrid and external LB, because every node must agree on it.
- Ranks are not inferred from `--nnodes`/`--node-rank`.
- Dense models are not rejected for external LB. `vllm serve` rejects them and points to independent instances instead.

A pre-existing issue, also present with Python-supervised hybrid LB on `main`: a request pinned to a rank the frontend does not own returns 400, but the body says only `engine-core error`. The detailed message ("rank 0 is not connected to this frontend; connected ranks: [2, 3]") is lost when the error is wrapped.

---

+### Hybrid and External DP Load Balancing
+
+Like `vllm serve` (see [Data Parallel Deployment](../docs/serving/data_parallel_deployment.md)), `vllm-rs serve` can run one Rust frontend per node that serves only the node's data parallel ranks, with an upstream load balancer spreading requests across nodes. Every node passes the global `--data-parallel-size`, the address of the node that owns rank 0 as `--data-parallel-address`, and the same explicit `--data-parallel-rpc-port`, because all engines join the handshake of the rank-0 frontend. For MoE models, the rank-0 frontend also runs the DP coordinator.
+
+```bash
+# Node 0: ranks 0-1
+vllm-rs serve <moe-model> \
+  --data-parallel-size 4 --data-parallel-size-local 2 --data-parallel-hybrid-lb \
+  --data-parallel-address 10.0.0.1 --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345
+# Node 1: ranks 2-3
+vllm-rs serve <moe-model> \
+  --data-parallel-size 4 --data-parallel-size-local 2 --data-parallel-start-rank 2 \
+  --data-parallel-address 10.0.0.1 --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345
+```
+
+For external load balancing, start one `vllm-rs serve` per rank with `--data-parallel-rank <rank>`. A request can be pinned to one of a frontend's ranks with the `X-data-parallel-rank` header, which takes the global rank. Unlike `vllm serve`, `--data-parallel-rpc-port` has no default here and ranks are not inferred from `--nnodes`/`--node-rank`.

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+use anyhow::bail;
+use clap::Args;
+
+use crate::cli::ManagedEngineArgs;
+
+/// Data parallel ranks whose engines one `vllm-rs serve` process launches,
+/// and which of them its frontend connects to.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct DataParallelTopology {
+    /// First data parallel rank of this node.
+    pub start_rank: u32,
+    /// Number of data parallel ranks whose engines this process launches.
+    pub local_size: usize,
+    /// Number of data parallel ranks across the whole deployment.
+    pub data_parallel_size: usize,
+    /// Whether the frontend connects only to this node's ranks (hybrid or
+    /// external DP LB) while frontends on other nodes serve the rest. Otherwise
+    /// one frontend connects to every rank (internal DP LB).
+    pub local_engines_only: bool,
+}
+
+impl DataParallelTopology {
+    /// Number of engines the frontend connects to.
+    pub fn frontend_engine_count(&self) -> usize {
+        if self.local_engines_only {
+            self.local_size
+        } else {
+            self.data_parallel_size
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Whether every engine the frontend connects to runs on this node.
+    pub fn frontend_local_only(&self) -> bool {
+        self.local_size != 0
+            && (self.local_engines_only || self.local_size == self.data_parallel_size)
+    }
+
+    /// First data parallel rank the frontend connects to. The frontend whose
+    /// range starts at rank 0 owns the deployment's handshake.
+    pub fn frontend_engine_start_index(&self) -> u32 {
+        if self.local_engines_only {
+            self.start_rank
+        } else {
+            0
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// Data parallel load-balancing arguments of `vllm-rs serve`: which ranks this
+/// node serves and whether its frontend serves only them.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Args, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct DataParallelLbArgs {
+    /// Rank of the data parallel group served by this process. Implies
+    /// `--data-parallel-external-lb`.
+    #[arg(long, env = "VLLM_DP_RANK")]
+    pub data_parallel_rank: Option<u32>,
+    /// First data parallel rank on this node. Implies
+    /// `--data-parallel-hybrid-lb` unless `--headless` is set.
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub data_parallel_start_rank: Option<u32>,
+    /// Whether to use "hybrid" DP LB mode: this node's frontend load
+    /// balances between its local data parallel ranks, while an external LB
+    /// balances between nodes. Set explicitly in conjunction with
+    /// `--data-parallel-size-local` and `--data-parallel-start-rank`.
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub data_parallel_hybrid_lb: bool,
+    /// Whether to use "external" DP LB mode: every data parallel rank runs its
+    /// own frontend, as in a "one-pod-per-rank" wide-EP setup in Kubernetes.
+    /// Set implicitly when `--data-parallel-rank` is provided.
+    #[arg(long)]
+    pub data_parallel_external_lb: bool,
+}
+
+impl DataParallelLbArgs {
+    /// Resolve the data parallel ranks of this process from the DP LB flags,
+    /// which keep their `vllm serve` meaning.
+    pub fn resolve(
+        &self,
+        engine: &ManagedEngineArgs,
+        headless: bool,
+    ) -> anyhow::Result<DataParallelTopology> {
+        let data_parallel_size = engine.data_parallel_size;
+        if self.data_parallel_hybrid_lb && self.data_parallel_external_lb {
+            bail!(
+                "`--data-parallel-hybrid-lb` and `--data-parallel-external-lb` cannot be enabled together"
+            );
+        }
+        if headless && self.data_parallel_hybrid_lb {
+            bail!("`--data-parallel-hybrid-lb` is not applicable with `--headless`");
+        }
+        if self.data_parallel_rank.is_some() && self.data_parallel_start_rank.is_some() {
+            bail!("`--data-parallel-rank` and `--data-parallel-start-rank` cannot be set together");
+        }
+
+        let topology = if self.data_parallel_external_lb || self.data_parallel_rank.is_some() {
+            let Some(rank) = self.data_parallel_rank else {
+                bail!("`--data-parallel-external-lb` requires `--data-parallel-rank`");
+            };
+            if !matches!(engine.data_parallel_size_local, None | Some(1)) {
+                bail!("an external data parallel rank requires `--data-parallel-size-local 1`");
+            }
+            DataParallelTopology {
+                start_rank: rank,
+                local_size: 1,
+                data_parallel_size,
+                local_engines_only: true,
+            }
+        } else if let Some(local_size) = engine.data_parallel_size_local {
+            // A start rank outside `--headless` implies hybrid LB, and hybrid LB
+            // with every rank on this node is internal LB. Hybrid LB with one
+            // local rank is external LB, which connects the same way.
+            let hybrid_lb = (self.data_parallel_hybrid_lb
+                || (self.data_parallel_start_rank.is_some() && !headless))
+                && local_size != data_parallel_size;
+            DataParallelTopology {
+                start_rank: self.data_parallel_start_rank.unwrap_or(0),
+                local_size,
+                data_parallel_size,
+                local_engines_only: hybrid_lb,
+            }
+        } else {
+            if self.data_parallel_hybrid_lb {
+                bail!("`--data-parallel-hybrid-lb` requires `--data-parallel-size-local`");
+            }
+            // Without a local size, the start rank is ignored.
+            DataParallelTopology {
+                start_rank: 0,
+                local_size: data_parallel_size,
+                data_parallel_size,
+                local_engines_only: false,
+            }
+        };
+
+        if topology.start_rank as usize + topology.local_size > data_parallel_size {
+            bail!(
+                "data parallel ranks [{}, {}) of this node exceed `--data-parallel-size {data_parallel_size}`",
+                topology.start_rank,
+                topology.start_rank as usize + topology.local_size
+            );
+        }
+        if topology.local_engines_only {
+            if topology.local_size == 0 {
+                bail!("hybrid and external DP LB require local data parallel ranks");
+            }
+            // Every node dials the handshake of the frontend owning rank 0.
+            if engine.handshake_port.is_none() {
+                bail!("hybrid and external DP LB require `--data-parallel-rpc-port`");
+            }
+        }
+        Ok(topology)
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use clap::Parser;
+
+    use super::DataParallelLbArgs;
+    use crate::cli::ManagedEngineArgs;
+
+    /// The `vllm-rs serve` flags that the topology is resolved from.
+    #[derive(Parser)]
+    struct ServeFlags {
+        #[command(flatten)]
+        engine: ManagedEngineArgs,
+        #[command(flatten)]
+        data_parallel_lb: DataParallelLbArgs,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        headless: bool,
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn resolve_follows_vllm_serve_dp_lb_modes() {
+        let cases: &[&[&str]] = &[
+            &["--data-parallel-size", "4"],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-size-local",
+                "2",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-size-local",
+                "2",
+                "--data-parallel-start-rank",
+                "2",
+                "--data-parallel-rpc-port",
+                "13345",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-size-local",
+                "2",
+                "--data-parallel-hybrid-lb",
+                "--data-parallel-rpc-port",
+                "13345",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--headless",
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-size-local",
+                "2",
+                "--data-parallel-start-rank",
+                "2",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-rank",
+                "3",
+                "--data-parallel-rpc-port",
+                "1",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-start-rank",
+                "2",
+            ],
+            &["--data-parallel-size", "4", "--data-parallel-external-lb"],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-rank",
+                "1",
+                "--data-parallel-start-rank",
+                "1",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-hybrid-lb",
+                "--data-parallel-external-lb",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-size-local",
+                "2",
+                "--data-parallel-start-rank",
+                "2",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-size-local",
+                "2",
+                "--data-parallel-rank",
+                "3",
+            ],
+            &[
+                "--data-parallel-size",
+                "4",
+                "--data-parallel-size-local",
+                "2",
+                "--data-parallel-start-rank",
+                "3",
+                "--data-parallel-rpc-port",
+                "1",
